entry.title: General comment No. 1 (2024) on article 4 of the Optional Protocol (places of deprivation of liberty)
entry.summary: General Comment / Recommendation · CAT/OP/GC/1 · Subcommittee on Prevention of Torture · 2024 — The Subcommittee on Prevention of Torture (SPT) clarifies the comprehensive scope of "places of deprivation of liberty" under article 4 of the Optional Protocol to the Convention against Torture (OPCAT).
